rationale: The description identifies a decision engine incorporating recommendation technology to help customers find products, but gives no recommendation mechanism. The function may be AI-dependent, yet no AI is affirmatively stated; non-AI is the best-supported forced binary choice.
evidence_spans: Intelligent decision engine platform which integrates recommendation technology into third party sites to help customers quickly find their ideal product.
conflict_response: The words 'intelligent' and 'recommendation technology' do not by themselves state AI, but the central recommendation function is unexplained and cannot be treated as clearly conventional. I select non-AI only as the best-supported binary outcome and retain weak/forced status.
